text:
olivia (oncall): pager: spike in 5xx + huge queueing on inference-us-west, started ~8m ago. /v1/generate and /v1/embed both affected. seeing inflight > max on several hosts.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-15-2400012345 — High 5xx + request queueing in runtime-us-west (sev2). Pager: olivia (oncall).

rick (sre): oncall ack. is this a traffic surge or backend stalls? any model-level skew?

olivia (oncall): broader but biased to model-neo-7b and embeddings-heavy customers. sample log: ```WARN runtime: request preempted: exceeded_deadline, inflight=320, max_inflight=300, queue_len=610, kv_swap_ms=4200```

jess (runtime): checking node telemetry — GPUs show low compute utilization on stalled pods; kernel threads blocked waiting on KV page-ins from remote store. I/O latency to NFS jumped to ~4s.

maya (support): multiple customers raising 502/504. acme-inc reporting production timeouts. opening priority tickets and notifying accounts.

tyler (pm): please keep a running customer-impact list. prioritize enterprise SLAs and any trial customers on fast paths.

rick (sre): proposed mitigations (immediate):
1) edge token-bucket limit for anonymous/free -> reduce ingress by ~25% (suggest 50r/m)
2) cut `max_inflight` for non-SLA routes from 300 -> 100 to shed long tail work
3) enable 429-with-Retry-After for free-tier long-running requests > 60s to avoid abort storms
4) disable request-context-merging and dynamic batching for /v1/embed for 20m
5) route large embedding jobs to embeddings-quant-2 variant by weight shift
6) temporarily increase enterprise timeouts to 120s to keep existing long jobs alive
7) issue ephemeral emergency quota +5000 tokens to acme-inc for 30m

olivia (oncall): agree. add: flip a temporary routing fallback for neo-7b -> neo-3b for free-tier when neo-7b queue_len > 250. we'll avoid thrashing by ramping rules over 60s.

jess (runtime): I'll apply runtime flags and propagate a gradual rollout. running commands now:```for node in runtime-nonent-usw-*; do ssh $node 'sudo set-runtime-flag max_inflight=100'; sleep 1; done``` Also adding fallback rule: ```if queue_len(model-neo-7b) > 250 then route->model-neo-3b```

deploy-bot: Runtime config change started by jess. See #deploys for progress.

rick (sre): edge patch: `edgectl set-rate-limit --tier=free --rate=50` and `gatewayctl set feature.dynamic_batching=false --path=/v1/embed` applying now.

jess (runtime): scaling action: spinning up 8 replacement pods in az-b and marking 5 stuck pods for eviction. command: `kubectl scale deployment/runtime-usw --replicas=$((CURRENT+8))` then `kubectl cordon`/`drain` on problem nodes.

maya (support): acme-inc confirmed they see fewer 5xx errors after we bumped their quota. I'll keep them on the line until stable.

olivia (oncall): monitoring: within 90s after rate-limit + max_inflight change, queue_len trending down on control plane. p99 for /v1/generate dropping from ~22s -> ~7.5s in the first 6m.

rick (sre): good. still seeing a small cohort of pods with repeated kv_swap_ms > 2000ms. we should replace those rather than mass-restart. continuing replacement.

jess (runtime): replaced 6 pods, autoscaler added 8. KV swap stalls reduced on replaced hosts. routing fallback enabled for free-tier.

tyler (pm): thanks — please note in comms we routed free-tier to smaller model when necessary. customers on paid plans unaffected except for slightly longer timeouts allowed.

rick (sre): metrics update: overall error-rate down from 7.1% -> 1.0% in 10m. ingress qps down ~24%. tail lat p99 = 6.8s.

maya (support): acme-inc support contact says system looks stable, they appreciate the token refill.

olivia (oncall): next steps: keep reduced `max_inflight` and edge rate-limit in place for 30m. revert embedding-batching off after 20m if stable. schedule postmortem to investigate NFS latency / KV swap hotspots.

rick (sre): taking lead for the handoff — olivia your shift ends in 18m. I'll keep monitoring and coordinate rollback when thresholds met: errors <1% and p99 <10s for 30m.

jess (runtime): note for postmortem: add an automated shield that triggers model fallback when `kv_swap_ms` exceeds threshold and a circuit-breaker to prefer quantized variants automatically.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-15-2400012345 status updated: mitigation_in_progress, owner=rick (sre).

maya (support): documenting affected accounts + mitigation steps in the incident ticket. leaving note for CS to follow up with trial users.

olivia (oncall): handing off now to rick. ping me if it spikes again. :white_check_mark:

rick (sre): taking over. will escalate if cross-team help required. logging all mitigation commands in the incident doc.

jess (runtime): will own postmortem write-up with root-cause data and propose automation to detect KV-page-in pressure earlier.

olivia (oncall): closing pager — monitoring continues, reopen if regression. :lock_with_ink_pen:
